name: ICANIAN 冠捷 P9 enduro frameset
why_interesting: Official evidence identifies a 150 mm rear-travel enduro frame intended for a 160 mm fork and flat MTB bar, but the repository's fixed road/gravel build allowance cannot represent an honest MTB complete build.
missing: Resolve the current manufacturer frame-weight conflict and exact included package
MTB-appropriate flat-bar complete-build specification and cost
Exact current mainland SKU, purchase route, warranty and return terms
source_note: Current exact manufacturer evidence confirms Toray T700/T800 construction, 27.5x3.0 or 29x2.3 fit and qualitative stiffness. Frame-only references conflict between 2,570/2,620 +/- 40 g and 2,400 +/- 20 g, so no single weight is selected.

facts.tire_clearance_basis: Current exact manufacturer frame page; nominal tire sizes, not measured casing widths
facts.frame_weight_status: Current manufacturer conflict: 2,570 +/- 40 g through M and 2,620 +/- 40 g in L versus 2,400 +/- 20 g on the complete-bike page
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer describes the exact P9 as stiff in key zones while compliant on rough terrain; qualitative claim without a numeric protocol
